# Agent / Team / Project / Ticket run drill-down
Optimize a specific **agent / team / skill** by drilling **ticket → run → spans + metrics** (ADR-0021 WS-F, ISI-4387). Attribute contract: `pkg/telemetry/semconv/registry.go` + `docs/observability/semantic-conventions.md`.

**Use:** pick a `ticket` (work-item ref) → pick a `run` → the run-trace, LLM cost/tokens, tool/skill error-rate and control-plane health below filter to your selection. `team`/`project` scope the roll-up tiles.

> ⚠️ **Skeleton pending live-data validation (ISI-4391).** DQL is schema-built; field/metric names are validated against the registry, not yet against live `dynatrace-dev` output.

1.title: Runs for ticket $ticket
1.query: fetch spans, from:-7d | filter span.name == "run.start" and ksquad.work_item.ref == $ticket | fields timestamp, ksquad.run.id, ksquad.agent.name, ksquad.team.name, ksquad.project.name, ksquad.run.state, ksquad.duration.ms | sort timestamp desc

2.title: Run-trace spans — run $run
2.query: fetch spans, from:-7d | filter ksquad.run.id == $run | fields timestamp, span.name, span.parent_id, span.id, duration, ksquad.outcome | sort timestamp asc

3.title: LLM tokens + cost — run $run
3.query: fetch spans, from:-7d | filter ksquad.run.id == $run and span.name == "llm.call" | summarize in_tok = sum(gen_ai.usage.input_tokens), out_tok = sum(gen_ai.usage.output_tokens), reason_tok = sum(gen_ai.usage.reasoning_tokens), cost_usd = sum(ksquad.llm.cost.usd)

4.title: LLM cost by agent (team $team)
4.query: fetch spans, from:-3h | filter span.name == "llm.call" and ksquad.team.name == $team | summarize cost_usd = sum(ksquad.llm.cost.usd), by:{ksquad.agent.name} | sort cost_usd desc

5.title: Backup/fallback-model activations by agent
5.query: fetch spans, from:-3h | filter span.name == "llm.call" and ksquad.team.name == $team | filter ksquad.llm.fallback == true or gen_ai.request.model != gen_ai.response.model | summarize activations = count(), by:{ksquad.agent.name, gen_ai.response.model} | sort activations desc

6.title: Tool/skill error-rate by agent + skill
6.query: fetch spans, from:-3h | filter span.name in ("gen_ai.tool.call", "mcp.call", "skill.load") and ksquad.team.name == $team | summarize calls = count(), errors = countIf(ksquad.outcome == "error"), by:{ksquad.agent.name, ksquad.skill.name, gen_ai.tool.name, ksquad.mcp.server} | fieldsAdd error_rate = errors * 100.0 / calls | sort error_rate desc

7.title: Lifecycle timeline — run $run (WS-D events)
7.query: fetch spans, from:-7d | filter ksquad.run.id == $run and span.name in ("run.scheduled", "run.sandbox_bound", "run.started", "run.ended") | fields timestamp, span.name, ksquad.work_item.ref | sort timestamp asc

8.title: Active runs by phase (WS-E) — team $team
8.query: timeseries active = avg(ksquad.runs.active), by:{phase, team}, from:-3h | filter team == $team
